messages:
alex: Quick sync — after yesterday's deploy we should decide which follow-on items to push into the 2-week micro-sprint. High-level: a customer-facing error spike (~1% in streaming fallback), a UX complaint about extra confirmation modals, and a perf hotspot in the embeddings batcher.
priya: +1. Error seems concentrated on long chats (>12k tokens). Do we want rollback-first (safe) or a hotfix that keeps users on the new path?
matt: I'm leaning hotfix: logs show KV cache GC thrashing when prefix cache grows; I can change batching policy and cap cache size as a quick patch.
olivia: Modal issue is low-effort — we can add a user preference toggle and hide the modal for returning users.
sam: Heads-up: two enterprise customers are asking to pin model versions — that's an enhancement but revenue-impacting. They'd trade runway for earlier delivery.
priya: Proposed triage: P0 = streaming error hotfix; P1 = modal toggle; P2 = pin-model enhancement + backlog refinement. Also add perf mitigations as part of P0 if small.
alex: Sounds reasonable. Can we realistically do P0 + P1 in 2 weeks if P0 is scoped to a hotpatch + canary? Matt, what's the ETA?
matt: If I scope P0 to: (a) cap KV cache to X entries, (b) change batching policy to prefer smaller groups for long chats, (c) canary in region-1 — I can get a PR by EOD tomorrow and a canary by Wed. Needs 1 day QA.
olivia: UI toggle + doc updates = 2 days for design + 1 dev day. Can deliver in sprint if prioritized.
sam: If we promise P2 ETA (rough estimate: 3 sprints) I'll handle comms with the customers. They want model pinning as a contractual ask, not immediate.
priya: I'll own triage and acceptance criteria. Draft AC for PROD-1827 (hotfix): 1) streaming fallback error rate reduced to <0.2% on canary region; 2) no regressions on short chats (<2k tokens); 3) automated smoke checks added to post-deploy; 4) rollback plan documented.
alex: Nice. For PROD-1831 (modal toggle) AC: 1) toggle present in user settings + quick override on next session; 2) telemetry event emitted on toggle; 3) docs/snippet for support.
matt: I'll attach repro logs to PROD-1827 and include a minimal test harness. Expecting to drop-in a config flag to control cache cap.
olivia: I'll attach mock and copy to PROD-1831.
sam: I'll draft an email to the two customers explaining timeline and tradeoffs, and offer a short call.
alex: Ownership recap: Priya owns triage + acceptance criteria, Matt owns PROD-1827 hotfix, Olivia owns PROD-1831 design/dev pairing, Sam owns customer comms and roadmap note for pin-model. I'll spin up the two tickets after this thread. Agree?
priya: Agreed. Also propose we schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 9:30am to unblock any cross-team questions.
matt: fine for me.
olivia: ok.
sam: thumbs up.
deploy-bot: deployment: scheduled canary for PROD-1827 at 1762140000 :rocket: 
alex: Great — thanks everyone. I'll create the tickets and a short rollout checklist. Keep updates in the ticket threads; re-open here only if we need to shift scope or pull in infra.
